newsitem.title: UK: LME People-Credit Lyonnais Rouse' Scrase to retire.
newsitem.headline: LME People-Credit Lyonnais Rouse' Scrase to retire.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) ring dealing member Credit Lyonnais Rouse Limited (CLR) said in a press statement that Graham Scrase, director of its LME department, has decided to retire on 31 March 1997.
An announcement will be made at a later stage of Scrase's replacement.

He was appointed a director in 1975 and has headed CLR's LME operations since their inception as an associte broker clearing member to their present status of a ring dealing member with an active presence in all metals.

The announcement also said CLR confirms its continuing commitment to the LME as a core activity in parallel with its rapidly growing business in structured finance for mines and metal processors which is conducted through Credit Lyonnais Rouse Derivatives -- a division of Credit Lyonnais SA.
